summary: A 60-ft steel tower built in 1928 in Idaho's Salmon-Challis National Forest; the log cabin burned in 2012 and the tower stands with broken rungs.

facts.design: 60-ft Aeromotor steel tower with 7x7-ft cab, plus a log cabin for living quarters
facts.status_note: The steel tower stands; the log cabin burned in 2012 and is gone.

access.note: No current road, gate or rental information in the sources. The site is on Salmon-Challis National Forest land.

visit.trail_note: No visitor route is described. The tower has broken ladder rungs and missing platforms, and the writer did not climb it.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Salmon-Challis National Forest (North Fork Ranger District cooperator)

corrections.why: The NHLR description, Forest Fire Lookout and Idaho Fire Lookouts all give 1928. The 1828 appears only in NHLR's Built data field and looks like a typo.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's Built field reads 1828, but its own description, Forest Fire Lookout and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1928. 1928 is used.
NHLR names the Salmon-Challis National Forest; Forest Fire Lookout says Salmon National Forest. The story uses the NHLR name.

notes_for_editor: Record's built year 1828 is a typo in NHLR's data field; 1928 is used. Sources disagree on end of use: Idaho Fire Lookouts says abandoned 1968, Forest Fire Lookout says not used since the 1970s. The cabin burning in 2012 rests on Forest Fire Lookout alone; the Idaho writer's 2012 photos show the cabin still standing. Access is unknown. The tower has broken ladder rungs and missing platforms; the story does not encourage climbing. Forest name differs between sources (Salmon vs Salmon-Challis). Idaho Fire Lookouts post dated January 16, 2023. Staffing history rests on that one site.
